name: Juvenescence
verdict: A private drug-development company co-founded by Dr. Greg Bailey, Jim Mellon and Dr. Declan Doogan. Nothing found.
note: Partner of the NorthStar SailGP Team 'to champion health, wellness and longevity' (SailGP press release, 22 Nov 2024). Rating note (2026-10-03): Juvenescence's co-founders are Dr. Greg Bailey, Jim Mellon and Dr. Declan Doogan (juvlabs.com/our-team); it is a private company, so its share register isn't public. Context: co-founder Dr. Greg Bailey acquired the Canada SailGP Team in 2024, which was renamed NorthStar (SailGP press release, 2 Oct 2024, sailgp.com/news/24/confirmed-canada-sailgp-team-sold-to-new-owners/). No state or state-fund holder was found, and no human-rights finding against the company was found. Juvenescence announced a UAE presence at Masdar City (juvlabs.com press release, 26 Feb 2026); a presence is not ownership.
